Trains to Biggleswade

This is the train I would look at for the Shuttleworth air shows. Thameslink calls at Biggleswade twice an hour each way on Saturdays, from London via St Pancras or from Peterborough, and hourly on Sundays, when southbound trains run to London King’s Cross. Shuttleworth runs its own shuttle bus from the station to the showground at every 2027 show, £10 return, booked with your show tickets.
